description_en: Seven stone memorial pillars from the 14th century.The pillars are located on the eastern side of the motorable path leading from the Dailekh Saṭaka (Dailekh Road) to Dullu. Currently lined up, it is said that it is Yogi Naraharinath who placed them as they are now (Sharma 2012, 99). This must have happened  in the late 1960's or after, since a photo taken in 1967 by Marc Gaborieau shows the pillars placed on both sides of the path (widened since). The seven pillars gave its name to the locality, Sātkhambā, also recorded on official maps of Nepal's Survey Department.The pillars present relatively similar typologies, with the upper sections following the same organisation: it is composed of two horizontal registers of egg-shaped patterns (āmalaka), separated by one plain rounded register. A bulb is carved on top. Below this is usually another plain rounded register, under which is a flat register that contains inscriptions.The artefacts of Sātkhambā are important for the archaeology and history of west Nepal as they contain dates ranging from 1334 to 1342 CE and mention the patronym Thāpā (Andolfatto 2019, 113;Pokharel 2011, 66-67). Pillars 003 and 004 contain inscriptions on two sides. Pillar 005 contains a shallow niche on the eastern side. This was probably used to display an inscription on metal.
description_ne: सातखम्बा पाषाण स्मृति स्तम्भ दैलेख सडकबाट दुल्लुतर्फ जाने मोटरबाटोको पूर्वतिर अवस्थित छ । लहरै रहेका यी सातखम्बालाई योगी नरहरिनाथले अहिलेको अवस्थामा ठड्याएको बताइन्छ (Sharma 2012, 99) । यो घटना सन् १९६० को दशकको अन्तिमतिर वा सोभन्दा पछि भएको हुनुपर्दछ किनभने सन् १९६७ मा Marc Gaborieau ले खिचेको तस्वीरमा यी खम्बाहरूको उक्त सडकको दुबैतिर रहेको देखिन्छ । अहिले उक्त सडक विस्तार गरिएको छ । यी सातवटा खम्बाहरूबाटै यस स्थानको नाम सातखम्बा रहन गएको हो । उक्त नाम नेपाल सरकारको नापी विभागले जारी गरेको नक्सामा पनि उल्लेखित छ ।यी खम्बाहरूका माथिल्ला अंशहरूमा पनि यस क्षेत्रका अरू खम्बाहरूको जस्तै दुई तहको आमलक बुट्टा देख्न सकिन्छ । अण्डा आकारको आमलक बुट्टाका बीचमा सादा गोलाकार अंश राखिएको छ । यी खम्बाहरूका टुप्पालाई बल्ब आकार दिइएको छ । खम्बाका तल्लो भागमा प्राय: एक अर्को सादा गोलाकार अंश राखी त्यसको मुनि वर्गाकार अंश रहेको हुन्छ । यस वर्गाकार अंशमा अभिलेख राखिएको हुन्छ ।सन् १३३४ देखि १३४२ सम्मका मिति अंकित यी सातखम्बाका यी पाषाण स्तम्भहरू पश्चिम नेपालको पुरातत्त्व र इतिहासको अध्ययनका लागि महत्वपूर्ण छन् । यिनमा 'थापा' जात उल्लेख गरिएका छन् (Andolfatto 2019, 113;Pokharel 2011, 66-67) । Pillars 003 र 004 मा दुईतिर अभिलेख कुँदिएका छन् । Pillar 005 मा पूर्वपट्टि साँघुरो गवाक्ष रहेको छ । सम्भवत: यसमा धातुको अभिलेख प्रदर्शन गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्थ्यो ।

historical_events.event_description: The east side of the pillar is inscribed. The inscription contains 5 lines in Nāgarī script. According toPokharel(2011; p. 67) another side contains an inscription bearing the date ŚS 124.... This could not be verified in situ. If true, it would situate the pillar between 1318 and 1327 CE.

The west and north sides of the pillar are inscribed. The inscription to the west contains 6 lines in Nāgarī script. It mentions the date Śake 1256 (1334 CE). The inscription to the north contains 5 lines, no date but bears the name Thāpā and the mention of a son (putra).

The west and north sides of the pillar are inscribed. The inscription to the west contains 5 lines in Nāgarī script. It mentions the date Śake 1256 (1334 CE). The inscription to the north contains 5 lines and no date.D. R.Sharma(2012: p. 101) reads the inscription as follow:Oṁ swosti śri sāke 1256 ghi a putra Bāmu Khadgā ko bira khaṃtranslated as:Hail, saka 1256 (1334 A.D.) this is the memorial pillar of Bāmu Khadgā
The east side of the pillar is inscribed. The inscription contains 6 lines in Nāgarī script. It mentions the date Śake 1264 (1342 CE) as well as the patronym Thāpā.
The north side of the pillar contains 4-5 lines of an unreadable Nāgarī inscription.
